message.zh: 26.4.16 是重要更新：新增铁牛排行榜、徽章与经验速度；修复任务刷新图片和锁定串联，战斗状态栏改为单行循环滚动并让 Debuff 跟随实际目标；同时加入市场备用接口、理论命中率、任务代币资产开关，并修复本地化数值、资产历史、无限队列、购物车、生产与公会兑换等问题。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.16 is an important update. It adds Iron Cow rankings, badges, and XP rates; fixes rerolled task artwork and isolated locks; changes battle status bars to a single-row marquee and keeps Debuffs on affected targets; adds marketplace fallback, theoretical accuracy, and a Task Token asset switch; and fixes localized numbers, asset history, infinite queues, shopping, Production, and Guild exchanges. Update on Greasy Fork.
